title: Complementary Property of sin and cos
description: The sine of the complement of an angle is equal to the cosine of the angle.

example.question: Find sin 60° using the complementary property.

note: Useful for converting sine into cosine.

title: Complementary Property of cos and sin
description: The cosine of the complement of an angle is equal to the sine of the angle.

example.question: Find cos 30° using the complementary property.

title: Complementary Property of tan and cot
description: The tangent of the complement of an angle is equal to the cotangent of the angle.

example.question: Find tan 30° using the complementary property.

title: Negative Angle Properties
description: Shows how trigonometric functions behave for negative angles.
note: Sine and tangent are odd functions, while cosine is an even function.

title: Periodicity of Trigonometric Functions
description: Trigonometric functions repeat their values after a fixed interval called the period.
note: The period of sine and cosine is 360°, while the period of tangent is 180°.
